title: Viralyzer
tagline: An AI-powered agent that analyzes social engagement, mints dynamic NFTs, and distributes tokens to incentivize viral content. Integrated with Coinbase AgentKit & Base for seamless onchain interactions.
description:
AI-Powered Social Monetization: Automating Engagement with Web3 & AgentKit
This project introduces a fully automated engagement monetization system that turns Twitter activity into real Web3 rewards—NFTs and ERC-20 tokens. Powered by AI, Coinbase AgentKit, and Base L2, this system allows creators to post tweets, track engagement, and distribute onchain incentives—all without manual intervention.

Key Features:
✅ AI-generated tweet content & images (DALL-E)
✅ IPFS Metadata & NFT Minting (via Pinata & AgentKit)
✅ Token Deployment on Base L2 (via Coinbase Developer Platform)
✅ Live Twitter Engagement Tracking (likes, retweets, comments)
✅ Automated Reward Distribution (ERC-20 tokens to engaged users, NFTs to commenters)

📢 Demo in Action:
1️⃣ The AI agent tweets & posts an image → https://x.com/0xReymon/status/1888629586399031330
2️⃣ NFT Metadata Generated → https://coffee-worrying-swallow-807.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/QmbDt42PmwVL4gyNGofMaso873P3Rkjiq8s4FTDmvFDacp
3️⃣ ERC-20 Token Deployed → https://sepolia.basescan.org/tx/0xfec82c8a91418088478d790f08ab2160c550eac248c0318f613bdb0273ad4cbf
4️⃣ Engagement tracked & rewards distributed

This system creates a circular economy where engagement = value, and turns followers into active participants in the creator’s digital ecosystem. No manual rewards, no middlemen—just pure, AI-powered Web3 automation!
how_its_made:
Stack: AI, Blockchain, and Agentic Automation
We built this project using a modular pipeline that seamlessly integrates AI-generated content, Twitter engagement tracking, and Web3 onchain interactions.

🚀 Step-by-Step Execution Flow
🔹 Step 1: AI-Generated Tweet & Image

Uses OpenAI's DALL-E to create a unique image.
AI generates tweet content based on trending Web3/AI topics.
Posts the tweet via Twitter API (OAuth 2.0).
🔹 Step 2: Uploading Metadata to IPFS

The tweet content & image are uploaded to Pinata (IPFS).
Creates an immutable, decentralized NFT metadata file.
🔹 Step 3: NFT & Token Deployment on Base L2

Uses Coinbase Developer Platform (CDP AgentKit) to deploy an ERC-20 token & mint an NFT.
Deployed Token Transaction: Base L2
NFT Metadata: IPFS Metadata
🔹 Step 4: Engagement Tracking & Wallet Address Extraction

Twitter API v2 tracks likes, retweets, and comments.
Wallet addresses extracted from comments for NFT rewards.
🔹 Step 5: Reward Distribution

ERC-20 tokens sent to engaged users (likes, retweets).
NFT randomly awarded to a commenter.
Executed fully on-chain via AgentKit (no manual transactions).
💡 Why AgentKit & Base L2?
🔹 Gasless & cost-effective token deployments.
🔹 Seamless agentic execution with programmable automation.
🔹 Abstracts complex Web3 interactions into simple API calls.
🔹 Fully on-chain & decentralized—no intermediaries.
